doc: Task 8: killing a networked job's sidecar ends the job `infra` with the sidecar's exit code in its log. Needs rootless podman 5+, the relay binary `drgnx-px-<arch>-linux-musl` next to the hub binary, and a host lane (`requires: podman, linux`); the fixture is busybox httpd on the host's loopback (host network), reached as fixture.drgnx.test pinned to 127.0.0.1. Unverified until the combined pass's host lane.

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work $ROOT/www; echo fixture-ok > $ROOT/www/index.html; printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))) (drgnx-agents-net-hosts ((packages "fixture.drgnx.test:18080" "fixture.drgnx.test:18081"))) (drgnx-sandbox-proxy-pinned-addresses (("fixture.drgnx.test" . "127.0.0.1"))))\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

set -e; podman rm -f cn-fixture-http >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; podman run -d --rm --network=host --name cn-fixture-http -v $ROOT/www:/www:ro,z docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 httpd -f -p 127.0.0.1:18080 -h /www >/dev/null
sleep 2; podman kill $(podman ps -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$job --filter name=drgnx-px-)
test -z "$(podman ps -a -q --filter label=drgnx.job=$job)"; podman rm -f cn-fixture-http >/dev/null 2>&1; true
